limits.cmp-test: Only named original-source common/JVM assertions ran; no OS input, screen reader, platform motion or mobile evidence follows.
limits.leptos-test: Original-source Rust examples and SSR assertions only; no browser keyboard walk, assistive technology or pixels follows.
limits.cmp-os: The supported preview launch and failed CUA app binding are separate from passing JVM tests/captures. No OS input was observed.
limits.lp-runtime: Bounded Safari session2/current-session3 observations with named source and element; CSS viewport/zoom uninstrumented, no full keyboard/IME/AT/motion acceptance.
limits.capture: Exact component/state mapping only. A capture/test is not automatically opened or compared against a matching design reference.
limits.source-use: Literal/dynamic references show source consumption; they do not establish visible use in a particular rendered state.
limits.suite: Suite PASS cannot be projected onto every registered state. Assertions reference their precise scope and historical test source revision.
